title: Nirmala Sitharaman Becomes Longest-Serving Finance Minister (9th Consecutive Budget)
summary: FM Nirmala Sitharaman presented her 9th consecutive Union Budget on 1 Feb 2026, surpassing C.D. Deshmukh's continuous tenure of 6 years 2 months.
